items.summary: McMurray Family Director of Athletics Boo Corrigan and head coach Philip Rivers have announced that Jatavis Sanders has accepted the role of General Manager for the NC State Football program. items.title: Rivers Named Head Coach for NC State Football
items.summary: RALEIGH, NC – NC State's McMurray Family Director of Athletics Boo Corrigan has announced that former Wolfpack quarterback Philip Rivers has been named the head coach for Wolfpack Football. A 17-year NFL veteran, Rivers remains the ACC's all-time leading passer more than two decades after his college career ended.
